title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #2

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the verse "Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Say: Allah is One
   B. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   C. Read in the name of your Lord
   D. Allah is the Most Great

2. "Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin" means (1 mark)
   A. I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
   B. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
   C. Allah is the greatest
   D. Say: He is Allah, the One

3. How many verses are in Surah Al-Ikhlas? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 6

4. "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals." Who narrated this hadith according to the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Hakim
   B. Ibn Majah
   C. Muslim
   D. Abu Lahab

5. Which of these is a trait of the Prophet's character? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Honesty
   C. Boasting
   D. Laziness

6. How should we treat a guest at the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Serve them first and respect them
   B. Eat quickly before them
   C. Ignore them
   D. Give them the smallest share

7. What can someone say if they forget Bismillah at the start of the meal? (1 mark)
   A. Allahu Akbar
   B. Nothing
   C. Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   D. Astaghfirullah only

8. Which of these is bad eating manners? (1 mark)
   A. Taking small bites
   B. Talking with a full mouth
   C. Sitting calmly
   D. Waiting for elders

9. What is oral hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Washing feet
   B. Cleaning the room
   C. Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   D. Cleaning clothes

10. Which three skills are named in the syllabus hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Reading, writing and drawing
   B. Cooking, sewing and farming
   C. Driving, typing and singing
   D. Swimming, archery and horse riding

11. What does physical fitness mean? (1 mark)
   A. Having many clothes
   B. Eating sweets
   C. Sleeping a lot
   D. A healthy, active and strong body

12. Which of these is a value from sports? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Boasting
   C. Anger
   D. Humility in winning

13. Rain that falls on farms of everyone is a sign of which name? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Basir
   B. As-Sami'
   C. As-Salam
   D. Ar-Rahman

14. How should we describe Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Like a big man
   B. Like a king on earth
   C. Like an angel
   D. Nothing is like Him

15. What is the duty of Raqib and Atid? (1 mark)
   A. To blow the Trumpet
   B. To take souls
   C. To bring rain
   D. To record our deeds

16. Which prophet is the ancestor of Yaqub? (1 mark)
   A. Ishaq
   B. Harun
   C. Dawud
   D. Musa

17. Who was the first prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Musa
   B. Nuh
   C. Adam
   D. Ibrahim

18. Which prophet is famous for patience during illness? (1 mark)
   A. Ayyub
   B. Hud
   C. Yusuf
   D. Dawud

19. The Qur'an mentions prophets in Surah 6 verses 84-86 and other places. Why should we learn their stories? (1 mark)
   A. To avoid work
   B. To boast
   C. To become kings
   D. To learn lessons and virtues

20. What is the main tool for removing najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Perfume
   B. Pure water
   C. Paint
   D. Oil

21. What do we say at the start of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Nothing
   D. Goodbye

22. Before touching the written Qur'an (Mushaf), a Muslim should (1 mark)
   A. Only wash feet
   B. Skip cleaning
   C. Have wudhu
   D. Be in a hurry

23. In which city is the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Makkah
   C. Madinah
   D. Nairobi

24. Why do Muslims all over the world face the same direction? (1 mark)
   A. It unites us
   B. For sport
   C. To confuse others
   D. By accident

25. What do we say when rising from ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Alhamdulillah alone
   B. Amin
   C. Bismillah
   D. Sami'allahu liman hamidah

26. Which posture is closest to Allah, according to the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Sujud
   B. Ruku
   C. Qiyam
   D. Taslim

27. What is the plural of rukn? (1 mark)
   A. Arkan
   B. Shuruut
   C. Suwar
   D. Sunan

28. What is niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Intention
   B. Bowing
   C. Greeting
   D. Standing

29. In the Prophet's story, the man gave water to which animal? (1 mark)
   A. A horse
   B. A goat
   C. A dog
   D. A cow

30. Who owns all creatures? (1 mark)
   A. The government
   B. Allah
   C. Farmers
   D. Zoos

31. What does adornment mean? (1 mark)
   A. Making oneself look neat and nice
   B. Hiding
   C. Praying
   D. Fasting

32. What does Qur'an 93:10 say about the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Do not drive him away
   B. Ignore him
   C. Shout at him
   D. Laugh at him

33. What can you do to memorise a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Sleep on it
   B. Read it once
   C. Repeat it line by line with a partner
   D. Never practise

34. Who deserves the best company according to the hadith, asked three times? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Your neighbour
   C. Your friend
   D. Your mother

35. Which is honest behaviour toward parents? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming others
   B. Telling the truth and not hiding things
   C. Hiding
   D. Lying

36. Which is an example of respect? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Greeting parents with a smile
   C. Answering back
   D. Interrupting

37. Which greeting is used with relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Shouting
   B. Insults
   C. Silence
   D. As-salamu alaykum

38. Which angel came with the angel of the mountains? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Mikail
   C. Raqib
   D. Jibril

39. What is the period of Khadija's and Abu Talib's deaths called? (1 mark)
   A. The Year of Elephant
   B. The Year of Hijrah
   C. The Year of Joy
   D. The Year of Sorrow

40. What did some people of Taif do as he left? (1 mark)
   A. Followed him
   B. Cheered him
   C. Gave him food
   D. Threw stones at him

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the meaning of the dua for leaving the house. (3 marks)

42. State four conditions of swalah. (4 marks)

43. Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house. (3 marks)

44. Explain the rule when you are unsure whether wudhu broke. (3 marks)

45. What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties? (3 marks)

46. State four duties of children to their parents. (4 marks)

47. How did Prophet Ibrahim (A.S.) show generosity? (3 marks)

48. Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra". (4 marks)

49. Explain the difference between patience and revenge with a school example. (3 marks)

50. State three ways Khadija (R.A.) helped the Prophet (S.A.W.). (3 marks)

51. Describe how parents should correct children who do wrong. (4 marks)

52. Explain why keeping family ties is important. (4 marks)

53. Give the meanings of shangazi, mjomba and binamu. (3 marks)

54. Explain the message of the last verse of Surah Al-Kafirun. (3 marks)

55. How can you apply the teaching of Al-Falaq about envy in your daily life? (3 marks)

56. How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely? (3 marks)

57. Describe what a siwak is and how it is used. (3 marks)

58. Give two good habits that keep a toothbrush healthy. (2 marks)

59. What is a pillar of swalah? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   This is the fifth verse of Al-Fatiha.

2. B — All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
   This is the second verse of Al-Fatiha.

3. B — 4
   Al-Ikhlas has four verses.

4. A — Al-Hakim
   The syllabus gives Al-Hakim as the narrator.

5. B — Honesty
   The Prophet was known as trustworthy and truthful.

6. A — Serve them first and respect them
   Hospitality is a Muslim value.

7. C — Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu
   The Prophet taught this for one who forgets.

8. B — Talking with a full mouth
   Chewing with the mouth open and talking is impolite.

9. C — Keeping the mouth and teeth clean
   Oral means mouth.

10. D — Swimming, archery and horse riding
   The hadith says to teach children these skills.

11. D — A healthy, active and strong body
   Fitness means the body is healthy.

12. D — Humility in winning
   A Muslim thanks Allah and stays humble.

13. D — Ar-Rahman
   Allah's mercy covers all creatures.

14. D — Nothing is like Him
   Allah is not compared to His creation.

15. D — To record our deeds
   They write what a person says and does.

16. A — Ishaq
   Yaqub was the son of Ishaq.

17. C — Adam
   Adam was the first human and prophet.

18. A — Ayyub
   Ayyub was tested with illness and stayed patient.

19. D — To learn lessons and virtues
   The stories teach us how to behave.

20. B — Pure water
   Allah sends pure water from the sky.

21. B — Bismillah
   Bismillah begins good deeds.

22. C — Have wudhu
   Most scholars say wudhu is required.

23. B — Makkah
   The Kaaba is in Makkah.

24. A — It unites us
   The Qibla unites Muslims.

25. D — Sami'allahu liman hamidah
   Allah hears the one who praises Him.

26. A — Sujud
   A servant is closest in sujud.

27. A — Arkan
   Arkan means pillars.

28. A — Intention
   Niyyah is intention.

29. C — A dog
   Allah forgave him for it.

30. B — Allah
   We are caretakers.

31. A — Making oneself look neat and nice
   Adornment is beautifying.

32. A — Do not drive him away
   We should be kind.

33. C — Repeat it line by line with a partner
   Practice helps.

34. D — Your mother
   Then the father on the fourth time.

35. B — Telling the truth and not hiding things
   Honesty.

36. B — Greeting parents with a smile
   Respect is shown by manners.

37. D — As-salamu alaykum
   A Muslim greeting.

38. D — Jibril
   Jibril and the angel of the mountains.

39. D — The Year of Sorrow
   The Prophet lost two supporters.

40. D — Threw stones at him
   His feet were hurt.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Islam and sanity; purity; covering the awrah; facing the Qibla; the time has come.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each condition.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: If you were sure you made wudhu and only doubt it broke, you remain in wudhu, because certainty is not removed by doubt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for staying in wudhu, 1 mark for certainty, 1 mark for the example.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Obey in good, respect, thank and make dua, help at home, care for them when old, be honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: When guests came, he quickly brought a fattened calf to serve them and welcomed them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for guests, 1 mark for the food, 1 mark for welcome.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four ways.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience is staying calm and trusting Allah, while revenge is hurting back. If a classmate teases you, you stay calm and tell a teacher instead of fighting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for patience, 1 mark for revenge, 1 mark for example.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was first to believe, comforted him, supported him with wealth, stayed with him in hardship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (4 marks)
   Answer: With wisdom and gentleness, not cruelty. They should explain, listen, forgive small mistakes and set a good example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

52. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is Allah's command, it brings love, unity and support, brings blessing and is an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shangazi: father's sister; mjomba: mother's brother; binamu: cousin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: "For you is your religion and for me is mine." A Muslim stays firm in his faith and respects the right of others to hold their beliefs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for firmness, 1 mark for respect.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Seek Allah's protection from envy, be happy when others do well, and do not wish harm on them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seeking refuge, 1 mark for being happy for others, 1 mark for not wishing harm.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is a small stick from a tree such as the arak. One end is chewed to make fibres, and it is rubbed on the teeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stick or tree, 1 mark for chewing the end, 1 mark for rubbing the teeth.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not share it and change it when the bristles are bent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: A part of the prayer which must be done for it to be valid.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for part and 1 mark for validity.
